title: Comfort letters; authority to assess fees; established.
bodyText: The department may assess and collect a fee for the issuance of any comfort letter of the department. All fees collected under this section shall be deposited into the tax administration special fund established under section 235-20.5.
bodyHtml: [§235-20]  Comfort letters; authority to assess fees; established.  The department may assess and collect a fee for the issuance of any comfort letter of the department.  All fees collected under this section shall be deposited into the tax administration special fund established under section 235-20.5. [L 2004, c 215, pt of §3]
